description: This file defines a PHP class 'PerformanceTrackerSearchFilterParams' within the 'OrangeHRM\Performance\Dto' namespace. The class extends 'FilterParams' and adds a property 'empNumber' with getter and setter methods, as well as default sorting behavior. It is used to encapsulate search filter parameters specifically for performance tracker searches in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class that encapsulates search filter parameters for performance tracker queries, including sorting options and optional employee number filter.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with default sorting by 'performanceTracker.modifiedDate' in descending order.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter value, or null if not set.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter value.
